patches.title: EXs 170 Kelfar Maestro
patches.description: Classical Arabic instruments for Kronos: Oud, Kanun, Buzuk, Nay, Kawala, Mejwiz, Arghool, Violin, and String Ensemble (~1.4GB PCM, 40 Programs, 32 Combinations).

patches.title: EXs 95 Kelfar Melodia
patches.description: East-meets-West library with Middle Eastern instruments (Zourna, Kanon, Oud, Arabic Guitars, Nay, Bouzoki) plus Western sounds. ~614MB PCM, 256 Programs.

patches.title: EXs 171 Kelfar Sha'bi
patches.description: Sha'bi / dabka-oriented oriental library using physical modeling: rababa, shebbabeh, nay, mejwiz, mizmar, bakhira, yarghul, zamr, plus guitars and layered club sounds.

patches.title: KRS 95 Kelfar Moda
patches.description: Companion KRS library for EXs95 Melodia focused on Sha'abi dance music. 128 programs with modeled Middle Eastern winds and leads (requires EXs95).

patches.title: EXs 250 Kelfar Club Strings
patches.description: World strings designed for Arabic, Turkish, Balkan, and Greek music with portamento legato; also covers contemporary club/EDM string roles.

patches.title: EXs 252 Kelfar Omega Kanun
patches.description: Physically modeled and hybrid Kanun library for NAUTILUS/KRONOS (~1.27GB PCM, 64 Programs, 46 Combinations).

patches.title: Oriental Pack (Oriental Essence)
patches.description: Nord Stage 4 preset pack with oriental/Arabic-flavored sounds including Nay, Istanbul layers, Arabic mixes, Uduk solo, and Arabic Night drums.

patches.title: 27 Ultimate Sounds V4 (ethnic accents)
patches.description: General Nord Stage 4 soundset that includes ethnic-leaning patches such as Modern Sitar, Pure Santur, Pure Dulcimer, and hybrid world textures useful for oriental arrangements.

patches.title: Montage factory ethnic / world performances
patches.description: Stock Montage waveform set includes regional ethnic kits and world parts (including Middle East–oriented drum sets). Melodic Arabic/Turkish/Iranian voice depth is limited versus arranger expansions.

patches.title: Motif XF / MOXF libraries (Montage-compatible path)
patches.description: Montage can import Motif XF/MOXF user voices and waveforms (.X3A/.X3V/.X3W). Primary practical path for third-party oriental content until native Montage Arabic packs appear.

patches.title: Community request: ethnic/Arabic libraries for Montage
patches.description: Ongoing community discussion noting weak dedicated Arabic/Turkish/Iranian melodic libraries for Montage; PSR/Genos oriental expansion packs are not loadable on Montage.
